articleTitle: Multiobjective Optimization of Electromechanical Servo Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The method of multiobjective optimization of nonlinear robust control by electromechanical servo systems with parametric uncertainty is developed. Synthesis of nonlinear robust controllers and nonlinear robust observers reduces to solving the Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs equations. Robust control target vector is determined by solving the multiobjective nonlinear programming problem in which the components of the objective function vector are direct quality indicators that are imposed to the system in various modes of its operation. The calculation of the objective function vector and constraints are algorithmic and reduces to modeling of the system with nonlinear robust controllers for various modes of the system operation with different input signals and for various values of the plant parameters. The dynamic characteristics modeling end experimental researching results of a synthesized nonlinear electromechanical servo system are present.

Author Keywords: dynamic characteristics simulation and experimental researches

articleTitle: The Use of Electrical Monitoring and Surveillance Systems to Prevent Emergencies of a Terrorist Nature (on the Example of Motor Vehicles)
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper proposes an innovative approach to the use of electrical monitoring and surveillance systems for the prevention of emergency situations of a terrorist nature at secure facilities/guarded objects of critical infrastructure. Using the example of motor vehicles operating near the object, it is shown that the use of data obtained by electrical monitoring and surveillance systems will make it possible to identify the accumulation of negative factors, including the preparation of an act of terrorism.

articleTitle: System for Visualization the Map of Air Pollution by Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: To control the air pollution the electric sensors are used, which convert the concentration of pollution into an electrical signal. After pre-processing data from electrical sensors is visualized on the map. However, this approach requires a large amount of measurements. In this paper, methods and means of visualization of pollution by motor vehicles are offered not only based on data from electric sensors, but also data obtained based on modeling results. The software architecture and its components are proposed.

articleTitle: Computer Model of the Electromechanical System of Moving Electrodes of an Arc Furnace with a Combined Control Law
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: A mathematical model of a combined law for an electric arc furnace (EAF) arc length regulation is proposed. The structure and parametric degrees of freedom of the Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy output system have been substantiated for EAF electrodes movement control signal generation governed by the combined law. A computer Simulink-model of the arc power controller utilizing the combined law of regulation for the EAF electric mode (EM) coordinates has been created. On the basis of this created Simulink-model, the research of the EM coordinates regulation dynamics indices using the proposed combined law and known differential law has been carried out. A comparative analysis of the mass production ARDM-T type arc power controller (automatic controller of arcs, mechanical, thyristor) dynamics indices under a differential law and with the use of the proposed combined law in its structure has been made. The obtained study results have confirmed the expediency of using the suggested combined control law, under which the dynamic accuracy of the ARDM-T controller EM coordinates stabilization is improved.

articleTitle: Investigation of SAR (Specific Absorbtion Rate) in Different Head Models Placed in Shielded Space
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: This article deals with effects of electromagnetic (EM) fields to different types of numerical models of human head. There are differences between specific absorption rate (SAR) near human head model inside shielded space like in elevator or non-shielded space (open area). In the presented approach, the investigation is focused on modelling of EM field proceeded on the finite integration method. The simulations were carried out for specific scenario where a person/passenger was placed in the shielded space using a cellular phone. The results were evaluated in terms of the SAR values - the determination of EM energy absorption inside the human head. The dipole antenna with a frequency of 900 MHz was designed and working as radio frequency source. In the proposed matching method, two models of human head - SAM homogenous human head model and AustinMan model - were chosen to model three different distances of the cellular phone from the human head surface. Both have the dielectric properties determined to the evaluated frequency of source. The numerical results have shown that the obtained maximal SAR values in shielded/enclosure (such as the elevator) is higher than are maximum values determined according to maximum SAR in European standards limit. Additionally, the obtained SAR values are higher than the results achieved by the open space simulations.

articleTitle: Passivity-Based Control of Hybrid Energy Storage System with Common Battery and Modular Multilever DC-DC Converter-Based Supercapacitor Packs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Hybrid energy storage systems (HESS) are often used in stand-alone power supply systems in order to conform fluctuations of electric energy generation and its consumption. In this work, bidirectional power supply system with battery/supercapacitor HESS based on a new topology of a two-way modular multilevel DC-DC converter of triangular structure was proposed. This topology is marked by high-boost and at the same time sufficiently simple due to the non-isolated configuration. Conducted investigation shows that only one SC pack must have a sufficient capacitance, but other SC packs may be low capacity. The capacitances of these SC packs depend from the power of one module of multilevel DC-DC converter and from the allowable error of DC bus voltage regulation. Because of significant nonlinearity and interconnection of the boost DC-DC converters, the passivity based control (PBC) approach was used. Effectiveness of the obtained control lows was demonstrated by the results of conducted simulation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Three-level Diode Clamped Inverter for Grid-connected Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) system applications in Renewable Energy Sources, Power Grid and Distributed Generation are widely increased due to rapid changes in the technology, crave for alternative clean energy, need to protect environment and also due to favorable regulations, incentives and the polices introduced by the various governments. The factors that should be taken into account when reliable power has to be transferred from PV to the end user are good quality, highly efficient and reliable power. If the PV module is giving peak reliability then the next important step to analyze is the PV inverter to improve the PV system reliability. There is a need of good reliable inverters and proper control of the inverter for reliable power supply with improved quality. This paper gives the analysis of three-level Diode Clamped Inverter connected to grid for improving the reliability of the PV system. The performance of DCI is studied and by using proper modulation technique for the grid connected inverter, the quality of output voltage and current increases which improves the power system reliability. The simulation is done in MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Identification of Gender Based on Speech Signal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The article presents a gender identification based on speech signal with supervised machine learning implementation. At first, a database of speech signals in Polish language was collected. Next, a set of features from audio signal were calculated. The features were farther used to train a neural network. Audio signal processing and implementation of the neural network were performed in Python, and the calculation of features in the R language. Neural network training process was carried out using only CPU, then CPU with GPU and the times of the programs execution were compared. The obtained accuracy of gender recognition was 92.4%. The use of GPU accelerated the network learning process several times.

articleTitle: Representation of Transmission and Distribution Networks in the Mathematical Model of the Electricity Market Equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The models of transmission and distribution power networks, which adequately reflect the physical properties of such networks in problems of modelling of the electricity market equilibrium, are suggested. The transmission network model, based on the theory of electrical circuits, establishes a connection between the power flow in power lines and the potentials at the network nodes in accordance with Kirchhoff's laws and the Hamilton's principle of the least action. Aggregated models of distribution networks seem to be quadratic dependencies of electricity losses in such networks on the value of final consumption. In the models of transmission and distribution networks the physical parameters of power lines are used, which makes it possible to use such models to solve practical problems of modelling equilibrium states of the electricity market. Unlike well-known models, the suggested network models do not include coefficients, which are difficult to identify. Those coefficients we directly determined by the existing parameters of power lines, which makes its possible to use suggested models to solve practical problems of finding equilibrium states of competitive electricity markets.

articleTitle: Regimes Balancing in the Local Electric System with Renewable Sources of Electricity
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Greater part of renewable energy sources is represented by solar electric stations (SES). Their operation mode depends on natural conditions of the region, where they are located. That is why the problem of RES stability estimation is important in the problem of covering the daily schedule of energy consumption. One of the aims of the research is to evaluate the probability of providing the consumption schedule by means of corresponding source on the base of statistic data. In this paper, the algorithm determination of stability covering load demand their own generation of renewable energy, particularly solar power, was proposed. On the basis of this indicator the method of determining the optimum by criterion of minimum reduced cost, power, which should provide a source of reserve to maintain an appropriate level of reliability in carrying the local electrical system. This method, based on the evaluation of stability data for generating renewable energy sources, including solar power, the problem of covering a given load demand and its impact on the number electricity.

articleTitle: Development and Analysis Methods of Transporter Electric Drive for Electrotechnological Complex of Crop Seed Presowing by Electromagnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Presowing seed treatment in a magnetic field allows increasing the crops yield, reduce the plants incidence and improve the products quality. The magnetic induction and the movement velocity in the magnetic field should be maintained at an optimum level during the seed treatment process. For this purpose, the electrotechnological complex was developed that consists of four pairs of permanent magnets and the transporter with electric drive. The change of the electric drive angular velocity of the transporter is affected by the load shift and the supply voltage change. For the transporter electric drive dynamics analysis an analytical expression for the drive drum efforts was obtained, which made it possible to determine the transporter mechanical characteristics for seeds of different crops and the electric drive power. The approximation of the transporter loading diagram on separate sections by linear functions is proposed, then the analytical expressions describing electromechanical transients in the electric drive could be obtained. The deviation of the electric drive angular velocity from the optimum value does not exceed 3.3% (with the load changes), and 1% (with a voltage permissible variation). The development method of electrotechnological complex for presowing seeds processing by magnetic field was described in the paper, the yield increasing of agricultural crops by it application based on previous researches is near 25-40%.

articleTitle: Influence of Stress Factors on Cognitive Tasks Performance
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Human-machine interactions in the modern world are becoming more complex and require even higher levels of understanding and attention from the person, especially in the military or medical industry. Wireless electronics, innovations in the field of nanoelectronics and nanosensors, a new approach to software systems design and information exchange enable the creation of complex systems that were unthinkable decades ago. This preliminary study focuses on the problem of the stress factors influence on the ability of a person to perform mental work. Within the framework of the study, the analysis of changes in human physiological parameters in stress conditions was monitored and experimental studies of the influence of stress factors on solving cognitive tasks using pupillometry were conducted. Objects of the current research were aged 16-25 years. Measurement of the size of the pupil and the pressure was carried out during the execution of cognitive tasks. The purpose of these studies is to to create a simple and optimal system for monitoring the quality of cognitive tasks under the influence of external stressors (noise, interference, vibration, etc.) for application in field conditions, verify if the reliable measurement is possible and to determine the recommendations to the measuring system sufficiently simple and sufficiently precise to carry out such measurements.

articleTitle: Model of Virtual Source of Reactive Power for Smart Electrical Supply Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: By analogy with the structure of the “virtual power plant” in the structure of intelligent electric grids “Smart Grid” proposed to introduce an additional component - a virtual power compensator, whose task is to provide a dynamic balance of reactive power in the system. As the distributed resource of reactive power, it is proposed to use consumers-regulators of active power, which are an integral part of virtual power plants. The results of simulation of modes of generation of reactive power by consumer-controllers of domestic or industrial power supply systems by means of power electronics are presented.

articleTitle: A Meta-Heuristic Data Routing Algorithm for Networks with Dynamically Variable Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the study of an ant algorithm for increasing the efficiency of the routing process in networks with dynamically changing structure. This algorithm is successfully used to solve complex optimization problems: the search and determination of the most suitable solution for optimizing the target function from a discrete set of possible solutions. In the paper as a target function is considered the time of data delivery. The modification of an ant algorithm of routing, which prevents the implementation of premature cycles, is presented.

articleTitle: A Simple Wireless ECG System for Education Practice
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: This article is focused on the design and the construction of the simple low-cost wireless ECG system for university education practices. The system is split into functional blocks performing particular functions. In separated sections, these blocks are described in detail. The paper presents analog circuit for acquisition and filtration of the ECG signal in detail. ATmega328p embedded in the Arduino Nano board is the primary component of the hardware dealing with signal digitalization. The wireless transmission of the digitalized signal is made by the HC-06 Bluetooth module. The end of the article deals with experimental measurements and the device's capacity to measure the ECG signal. The usage of our tool for educational purposes is also presented.

articleTitle: Improved Simulation Model of Electrical Breakdown in Air
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper presents critical analysis of most popular classical computational models of electrical discharge in air. Numerical models of switches and spark-gap arrestors are compared. Different phenomena of arc initiation are considered. On the basis of the presented analysis a refined model of showering arc is proposed.

articleTitle: The Simulation and Analysis of the Probabilistic Characteristics of Schemes for Power Supply of Electric Arc Furnaces in Non-symmetric Modes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The mathematical model of the innovative power supply system for electric arc steel smelting furnaces of alternating current with the converter “constant current - constant voltage” and the results of its studying in non- symmetrical modes with using a three-dimensional probabilistic model of stochastic load are given in the paper. The comparative analysis of the obtained indicators with the data for the convenient furnace power scheme was conducted. It has been obtained that in both supply schemes non- symmetrical load leads to the decreasing of the expected value of useful power that released in the main kiln area. However, with the converter “constant current - constant voltage” the useful power is 20-22% higher. It is also shown that the average probabilistic value of arc's negative-sequence current in the conventional power scheme of a furnace is 2.6-3.4 times higher. This causes losses increasing in the short grid and electrodes on average 12%.

articleTitle: Features of the Construction of Autonomous Diagnostic Systems of Electrical Equipment, Taking into Account the Modes of Its Operation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The structure of the diagnostic system is proposed. The energy harvesting (EH) technology is used to provide the functioning of autonomous measuring transducers which located on the parts of the electric machines (EM) in the system. It provides the possibility to carry out the power supply of electronic circuits in autonomous devices for measuring vibrations due to the transformation into the electric current of the mechanical energy of the vibration of the EM unit. The necessity of forming of the spaces of diagnostic features, taking into account the operating modes of the objects under study, has been proved at the examples of investigation of the vibration of bearing units of auxiliary engines. The obtaining of experimental data is carried out using a laboratory diagnostic system. It includes measuring transducers, functioning of the cat-rick is provided with the help of autonomous power systems.

articleTitle: Interval Modeling and Simulation of Active Knee Prosthesis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper deals with the study and development of the background for studying nonlinear multi-motor electromechanical systems. The proposed approach allows us to transform nonlinear exact mathematical model of the electric drive into piecewise linear interval form. Mathematical models in this form are described by piecewise linear differential equations which are simpler than nonlinear ones. These equations can be written down by using results of nonlinear functions' triangulation. One can use constructed linear-like models to study different modes of electric drive operations and to construct their trajectories of motion by considering some intervals of existence state variables.

articleTitle: Variational Method of Auxiliary Equations in Nonlinear Systems Analysis and Synthesis Problems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: To avoid the operation of differentiating the original equations matrix of coefficients, and find a parametric sensitivity matrix, we propose a method for constructing auxiliary first variation differential equations of nonlinear system state equations, written in coordinates and velocities. Auxiliary equations of the first variation are written in impulses. This allows you reduce the monodromy matrix to the multiplication of two matrices (the coefficients matrix and the auxiliary sensitivity to the initial conditions matrix), instead the operation of differentiating the original equations matrix of coefficients by argument that is almost impossible. The Cauchy problem and the boundary value problem for ordinary nonlinear differential equations of state and their first variation differential equations are solved. As an example, the results of transient and stable processes computer simulation of computerized control system executive object are given.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Research of Software Implemented Phase-Locked Loop with Improved Noise Immunity
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Improvement of the limiting noise immunity of the communication system is an effective way to increase the capacity of the communication system, which provides quality of service for bigger number users. This task can be solved by lowering the noise threshold of the phase-locked loop (PLL) in these systems on condition that dynamic properties of the device are preserved. This article is devoted to the analysis of the firmware digital PLL behavior under the simultaneous influence of noise and modulation of the input signal. The article depicts the structure of the modified digital PLL and explains its key difference from classical PLL. The results of simulation show that PLL is not able to detect all phase changes when the noise is present in communication channel because output signal does not reach the threshold level of detection. The results of the experimental research of the PLL dynamic behavior show that the duration of the transient processes during the BPSK signal processing in the modified device is at least twice as low as for the classical one. In addition, the number of errors during signal detection increases faster for classical PLL than modified one when the noise power grows. The use of the modified PLL in modern communication systems gives an opportunity to increase their capacity.

articleTitle: Calculation of Transients in Electrical Circuits at the Use of Solution Approximation by Tchebyshev's Polynomials
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The method of computer calculation of time dependences of transients in linear circuits is offered. The feature of method is application of solution polynomials approximation, and also development of scheme model of method, creating comfort at modeling for engineers. The offered method had showed stability at solution of integrally-differential equations and less calculation time as compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: Fast Removal of Decaying Offset in Relaying Input Signals
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a fast algorithm for removing of dc offset in current and voltage signals at the input of relaying devices. The method is based on phasor estimation in the input waves using a modified discrete Fourier transform (DFT). Thanks to proposed 3-state Least Error Squares (LES) algorithm the obtained outputs have specific symmetries which enables on-line control of suppressing the exponentially decaying dc components. The performance of the proposed algorithm is evaluated for faults on a 400 kV overhead transmission line. The Electromagnetic Transient Program (EMTP) is used to generate fault signals. The evaluation results indicate that adopting the proposed method in fault locators or relays can effectively suppress the adverse influence of exponentially decaying dc offsets reducing a transient delay to approximately a quarter a period.

articleTitle: Synthesis Algorithm of Proximate Time-Optimal Servo Drive with Constraint of State Coordinates
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The N - i switching method made it possible to establish analytical relations between the constraints of the state coordinates of the electric drive and the parameters of sliding mode control systems. This problem is solved for the cases of optimization in time domain and modal control. This paper presents a computational algorithm that implements a parametric synthesis of a control system taking into account changes in the levels of constraints caused by the performance of various shapes transient trajectories.

articleTitle: Stray Magnetic Fields of Toroidal Superconducting Magnetic Energy Storage (SMES)
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The stray magnetic fields of toroidal superconducting magnetic energy storage (SMES) as a system of individual coils are considered. It is shown that the stray field depends on both the number of coils, size coils, its relative position and also required dimensions and coil currents. To determine dimension characteristics, it is advisable to use the idealized model of the toroidal current surface. For approximate estimate of the stray field can be used simplified model of unidirectional current filaments.

articleTitle: Increasing Electric Network Reliability by Dispersed Generation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The article analyzes the pace of increase in the generation of photovoltaic stations in the context of the combined electricity system of Ukraine and the energy supply company of PJSC “Vinnytsyaoblenergo”. An analysis of existing regulatory documents regulating the work of photovoltaic stations has been carried out. Within the framework of the considered documents, the criteria for assessing the reliability of the operation of electric networks, namely, the length of long breaks in electric power supply of consumers of electric energy SAIDI are defined. The interconnection of the change of reliability indices of electric networks operation with the increase in the number and installed capacity of renewable energy sources, in particular photovoltaic stations (PV), is shown. In order to increase the reliability of power supply, a method of its renewal has been proposed, due to the joint use of generation of small hydroelectric power stations and PV stations.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulations in the Earthing Calculations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The following article presents the complexity of modeling and simulation process of earthing systems. There were described the solution for choice of the right model with reference to various functions performed by the earth electrodes and factors influencing this process. The exemplary results of numerical simulations were shown. At the end conclusions were drawn and listed.

articleTitle: Optimization of Operating Parameters for Examinations of Race Horses on X-Ray Tomosynthesis Units
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: It was proposed the optimization of operating parameters for digital X-ray tomosynthesis during the examination of race horses bones using a mobile system of X-ray tomosynthesis EqueTom. For measurements, a cattle joint phantom with test objects embedded in it was used. It was experimentally confirmed the contrast and resolution increasing of the test objects in slices of the tomosynthesis images of with increasing irradiation angle.

articleTitle: Numerical Model of Ohmic Heating for Random Aggregates
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The article describes methods used for numerical modelling of the ohmic heating applied in the food industry. The main challenge is related to mesh generation for a random aggregate structure composed of potato cubes immersed in the conducting fluid. The developed model can handle a cube size described by a probability density function. The maximal number of cubes in one layer is determined by the size of the tank. Using homogenization theory substitute parameters of the aggregate were determined.

articleTitle: Usage of Light-Emitting-Diode Lamps in Decorative Lighting
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The article considers the usage light-emitting-diode lamps in decorative lighting. The possibility of adjusting the brightness of the illumination of LED lamps, which do not have an integrated controller of regulating process of luminous flux, is considered. The electric circuit of the lighting system is proposed. The limits of voltage and current regulation are calculated. The estimation of the quality of electric energy input is given.

articleTitle: Modeling FACTS Device Impact on Voltage Flicker in the Electric Arc Furnace Supply System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: This paper discusses the issue of modeling voltage flicker compensation devices in electric arc furnace power supply system. Simple algorithms of modeling the arc furnace and the compensating device are presented. In the proposed model, the statistical indices of arc furnace active and reactive powers and their harmonic approximation in each time interval of one second are used. Such approach allows us to use the index <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Delta U_{10}$</tex> to estimate the equivalent effect of voltage fluctuations. The most annoying voltage fluctuations are within the frequency range of 1-25 Hz, and the efficiency of compensation devices in EAF power supply systems is dependent by their ability to reduce these fluctuations. The objective of the work is to create a simple tool for comparative assessment of compensation devices impact on voltage flicker in the EAF power supply system.

articleTitle: Transient Stochastic Processes in Power Circuits of Electric Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The analytical method for the purpose of analyzing the transient processes occurring in the power traction circuits of DC electric transport systems allowing to take into account existing stochastic character of electric traction voltages and currents has been proposed. The method is based on using a modified form of Duhamel's integral adapted to the theory of random processes, in which the weight function is determined by the solution of the Wiener-Hopf correlation integral equation. Based on relationships of the proposed method the numerical calculations of transient stochastic characteristics (the function of mathematical expectation, the function of correlation, root-mean square deviation and dispersion) of the locomotive current in freight train operation of the Prydniprovsk railway were carried out.

articleTitle: Piecewise Signals for the Iterative Control of the Voltage Conditioner
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper presents the iterative control of the shunt power electronic compensator. The single phase DC/AC inverter with PWM control is considered. The inverter generates the reactive current shifted to voltage. The required voltage amplitude is chosen as the objective function. The current amplitude is computed with the use the iterative algorithm based on secant method. The simulation results for the circuit composed of the simple grid model and DC/AC inverter is presented. The DC/AC inverter with the series inductor realize the current source. The simulations are done with the use of PLECS program. The control signals behave as piecewise constant time functions.

articleTitle: Magnetic Field Active Shielding Robust System Synthesis as Multi Criteria Game Decision Based on Particles Multi Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The robust system of active shielding synthesis method for magnetic field, generated by overhead lines is developed. The synthesis is based on the multi-criteria stochastic game decision, which based on the particles multi swarm optimization algorithms. Vector payoff calculated on the basis of the Maxwell equations solutions. System of active shielding synthesis initial parameters are the location of the high voltage power lines with respect to the shielding space, geometry and number of shielding coils, operating currents, as well as the size of the shielding space and magnetic flux density normative value, which should be achieved as a shielding result. System of active shielding synthesis objective is to determine their number, configuration, spatial arrangement, wiring diagrams and currents of shielding coils, parameters of the control system regulator as well as the resulting magnetic flux density value in the shielding space. Computer modeling and field experimental research of active shielding system synthesis carried out.

articleTitle: Video-Data Compression Using Wavelet Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: This research work focuses on researching and evaluating modern tendencies in video-compression, estimating possibilities and potential of wavelet-transform, transform at oriented basis specifically, in the context of visual data compression. For this purpose several types of wavelets (Haar, Daubechies and oriented basis) and cosine transform were compared and analyzed. Possible improvements on existing video coding standards featuring transform at oriented basis were proposed. Results regarding effectiveness of reviewed methods are presented.

articleTitle: Pedagogical Conditions of Formation of Professional Competences of Specialists in the Sphere of Electrical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the actual problem of formation of professional competencies of specialists in the field of electrical engineering. The basic components of professional competencies and fundamentals of training are considered. Described applications of the super-subject approach and pedagogical basis for training specialists in the field of electrical engineering. The proposed pedagogical conditions for the formation of professional values of future specialists in the field of electrical engineering, namely: the use of competency-based approach, the formation of professional culture of the specialist in electrical engineering and the implementation of the principle of integration with other engineering and social areas.

articleTitle: Electromechanical Laboratory Complex for Power Quality Studies of the Ship Electrical System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper presents an electromechanical laboratory complex created at the National University "Odessa Maritime Academy", which is used both in the educational process in preparing future marine electrotechnical officers, and in scientific research of the power quality of autonomous electrical systems, which include modern electric drives with voltage and frequency converters. As an example of solving research task, the power quality investigation of an autonomous power sup-ply network in the operating modes of electric drives with a fan's and pump's typical load are given.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of High-Frequency Wave Electromagnetic Processes in Power Transformers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The mathematical model of high-frequency wave electromagnetic processes in two-winding transformers has been developed. The model allows to take into account adequately electromagnetic couplings in windings and structural parameters of transformers in the form of boundary value problem for the system of partial differential equations.

articleTitle: Design of Linear Peristaltic Pump
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: A linear peristaltic pump is designed and modeled. The pump is controlled by a set of five electromagnetic actuators with ferromagnetic cores pressing in the given order an elastic tube with pumped liquid. The paper shows and describes the basic arrangement of the device, presents its mathematical model together with the numerical solution and compares selected results of simulation with experimental data measured on its prototype.

articleTitle: The Gamification Approach in Electrical Engineering Disciplines Teaching for Students with Special Needs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: This paper presents the gamification approach in educational complex for students with special needs (disabilities). Each game is created as electrical schema analysis. The approaches to the organization of the learning process of students with disabilities are considered. The architecture of the system is build.

articleTitle: Metallic Incubators in Bio-EMF Experiments – Possible Source of Discrepancies Between Research Groups and Results?
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The presented article discusses a possible issue when performing experiments employing electromagnetic field sources (e.g. exposure coils or antennas) to irradiate biological samples in a specific manner and fashion. In such scenarios, various research groups usually employ commercially available incubators with metallic cavities and components - thereby possibly influencing the expected spatial arrangement of the generated electromagnetic field and magnetic flux density thereof. We thus simulated several possible scenarios and calculated percentual variations in the minimum/maximum magnetic flux density values in the exposed water-like samples between the reference, custom-made non-metallic incubator and metallic incubator in various configurations. Additionally, the presence of heating elements in the incubator generates an unexpected electromagnetic field, complementing the intentionally generated electromagnetic field.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Electromagnetic Fields in Irregular Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The problem of matching waveguides of various cross sections with the help of a sectoral horn in quasi-optical waveguide paths is considered. A mathematical model of the system that can be used to minimize energy losses in the path is proposed. The mathematical model is obtained on the basis of the reduction of the Maxwell's equations system with the corresponding boundary conditions to the system of ordinary differential equations by replacing the reference system in which the irregular part of the waveguide system is served regularly, which simplifies the description of the boundary conditions.

articleTitle: Detecting Gait Anomalies Based on the Analysis of Foot Pressures
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The modern professional medical devices for gait analysis are very advanced but are not portable and available everywhere. However, the current information about our gait (“permanent” monitoring) might be helpful to improve our health condition. This paper describes the idea of gait anomalies detection by algorithms of deep learning. These algorithms analyze data collected by a prototype measuring device managed by a mobile application. Sensors collect foot pressure values as data for deep learning. The problem of collecting real data (from real patients) is discussed. The potential use of the device described is also discussed. Finally, assumptions and expectations regarding the results were compared with several related projects of deep learning and gait analysis. Our analysis of related studies shows that the use of deep neural networks (convolutional and recurrent) can have a satisfactory probability of detecting gait anomalies.

articleTitle: Numerical Modeling of Artificial Surface Cracks in Eddy-Current Non-Destructive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: This article deals with numerical modeling of artificial notches with varying geometry and electromagnetic properties. Austenitic stainless steel (AISI 316L) is investigated with the presence of volumetric surface cracks. Eddy-current inspection is applied under harmonic excitation. Huge parametric analysis is performed to investigate the behavior of selected parameters on the resulting eddy-current signal. Finite element method implemented in the commercial Opera software (by Vector Fields) is used for this purpose. The obtained results are presented and discussed in the paper.

articleTitle: Conditions for Limiting the Output Voltage of Double-circuit Semiconductor Discharge Installations with Positive Voltage Feedback
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The analysis of interrelated repetitive charge-discharge processes in the circuits of the reservoir capacitor of electric-discharge installations with positive voltage feedback is carried out. The regularities of increasing the charge voltage of capacitor during multiple cycles of its charge from the shaper of direct voltage and subsequent discharge of the capacitor through the load are determined. It has been substantiated that the output voltage of electric-discharge installations with positive feedback is limited in magnitude (due to energy losses in their circuits). The limiting voltages of the charge and discharge of the capacitor, the required number of cycles and the time to achieve limiting output voltage of the installation with the required accuracy are determined.

articleTitle: Cost Efficient CCD-based Spectrometer with Microprocessor/PC Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: CCD spectrometer based on TCD1304ap sensor and Arduino Uno was developed. The investigation was performed an example of a security system with logging into a database. The software for hardware implementation for the system has been designed. Proposed program consists a friendly graphical interface. The calibration procedure and practical examples are discussed.

articleTitle: Marine Electrical Power Plant Dynamic Modes Evaluation Using a Fuzzy Inference System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Fuzzy inference block for evaluating the dynamic modes in marine electric power plant using a fuzzy inference system is presented. The structure of new control system is presented. Linguistic variables for this system and rules base are presented. Evaluation of the results of simulation various modes in marine electric power plant using the developed system is presented.

articleTitle: Effects of Body Tissues Dielectric Properties on Induced Voltage on Cardiac Pacemaker's Lead
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper is concerned with the numerical modeling and assessment of the interference electrical voltage on the cardiac implant's lead model within the high-fidelity numerical phantom. The near-field exposure of the dipole antenna covering the GSM mobile phone transmission technology frequency was considered. The study was conducted by means of the numerical time-domain modeling utilizing the finite integration technique. The assessment was carried out in terms of the numerical calculations of the electric field distributions as well as the interference voltage induced on the implant's lead. The primary goal was to evaluate the effect of the tissue's dielectric properties on the levels of the induced voltage by changing the dielectric properties of the surrounding tissue layers: skin, fat, and muscle. Numerical results have shown that the variations of the induced voltage are less than ±6% when the conductivities and permittivities of the considered tissue layers vary up to ±10%. The results also indicate that the variations in the dielectric parameters of the muscle play a major role in the uncertainty of the estimates of the induced voltage compared to the other tissues considered.

articleTitle: Matrix Approach to Binary Code Sequences Optimization for Noise Immune Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper considers the problem of synthesis of code binary sequences (CBS) with optimal aperiodic autocorrelation functions according to the criterion of at least 4 levels of side lobes of the corresponding aperiodic autocorrelation function. The properties of algebraic operations in the finite fields are used to represent the above code binary sequences, their elements, and the convolution. The matrix, which determines the dependence between signs plus and minus of the elements of the binary sequences, also provide the possibility of establishing interrelation of the above-mentioned levels of side lobes. For the sequences of small dimensions, as an illustration, the analytical expressions of the specified relationship are given. The algorithm is substantiated and suggested, an example of synthesis of code binary sequences is given.

articleTitle: Development of Antennas Theory and Technique Based on Modulated Impedance Structures in Lviv Polytechnic University
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this article, the principles, methods and models of antennas based on periodically impedance structures at the Institute of Telecommunications, Radio Electronics and Electronic Engineering of the Lviv Polytechnic University are developed. The results of development of the original design of existing samples of disk impedance antennas with transverse radiation of an electromagnetic field, antennas based on a cylindrical impedance structure and the results of studies of their spatial ring antenna arrays radiation patterns, end flat antennas of surface waves based on periodically inhomogeneous al ribbed structures with impedance grooves, the results of experimental studies of the characteristics of the formation of diagrams directivity are presented of for cases of changes in the period of impedance inhomogeneities. These results using the method of Newton's analogies are the basis for the development of emitting structures for nanoscale technology.

articleTitle: The “Data Embassies” Concept as a Secure Communication Core for e-Gov Implementing in Emerging States
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: This paper depicts an approach to creation of reliable cloud platform, intended to support secure operation of government electronic services covered exterritorially by the sovereignty of a native state accordingly to International Laws. This work is high actual due to appearance a hybrid threats of a different kinds, especially in emerging states. It was briefly shown a change of cloud infrastructure to set up Data Embassies as the main part of e-Gov distributed service delivery platform. There were analyzed the main features of digital continuity support aspect. Thus, there the substantiation of an optimal topological solution is done for data embassies cloud info-communication system. It was shown that to choose the most appropriate telecommunication system network design on the IaaS and PaaS planes it is useful to adopt concrete topological design realization of distributed cloud in accordance with solution of presented equations, using initial topological network parameters. These approaches are good for purposes of finding the ways to organize effectively the system of distributed Data Centers plurality, and respective their inner SaaS or/and PaaS realizations, when optimization task object will consist of the structured set of handlers or virtual machines, respectively.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Electrocardiographic Processes Based on 3D Electric Circuit
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In the paper the mathematical model of the electrocardographic processes based on the analysis of three-dimensional electrical circuit is proposed. Parameters of passive elements of this circuit are determined by the geometrical dimensions and electrical characteristics of individual areas of the human body. Voltage source voltage in the circuit is equivalent to the electrical activity of the heart conductive system. The developed mathematical model of electrocardiographic processes takes into account the influence of such factors as the size of separate parts of the body, the location of the anatomical axis of the heart, pathology in the conductive system of the heart. It can be used to model tasks in the fields of vector-electrocardiography and tomography to study the electrical activity of the heart.

articleTitle: Adjustment of Material Characteristics in Electroheat Problems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: A frequent difficulty occurring in solving electroheat problems is correct setting of the temperature-dependent material characteristics. These are well known in the case of the pure metals, but not so much for alloys, as they depend on their chemical compositions. The paper presents a procedure how to approximate them using a suitable measurement and inverse solution of the corresponding problem. The methodology is illustrated with a typical example.

articleTitle: Electric Power Distribution System Fault Recovery Based on Visual Computation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: A study case of electric power distribution system fault recovery has been introduced in this article. With proper connections, network reconfiguration should be considered an effective solution to the system fault condition. Considering the radial structure of the distribution system, appropriate observation on visualized outcome of the voltage profile can lead the system operator to obtain the best switching line effectively. Contour plots are applied for visualizing the voltage profiles of a modified IEEE 13-node test feeder model.

articleTitle: Decomposition of the Controllability and Observability Matrices Into Symmetrical and Asymmetrical Parts in Linear Electrical Circuits
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: Decomposition of the controllability and observability matrices into symmetrical and asymmetrical parts of electrical circuits composed of resistors, coils, capacitors and voltage sources are addressed. It is shown that: 1) the Metzler matrix is Hurwitz if and only if its symmetrical part is Hurwitz; 2) if the linear electrical circuit is controllable (observable) then at least its symmetrical or asymmetrical part is controllable (observable).

articleTitle: Low Frequency Electromagnetic Field in Microenvironments and Their Possible Health Impacts
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The electromagnetic field is an inseparable part of the contemporary world. Ubiquity of low and extremely low-frequency electromagnetic field produced by the distribution of household electricity has attracted special attention. A number of dosimetric analyzes of the electromagnetic field realized by various researchers have detected high exposure values in the different microenvironment of human life. Other studies report potential associations between exposure to low and extremely low-frequency electromagnetic field and various health outcomes. This paper shows an overview of the electromagnetic situation in our life microenvironments and her possible health impacts.

articleTitle: Simulation of Electromagnetic Field Near Electronic Baby Monitor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The paper focus on non-ionizing electromagnetic field (EMF) radiation segment on the frequency 1.9 GHz EMF simulations results. Simulations are performed in CST Studio Suite. The homogenous model of human infant is used for simulation of EMF exposure. The SAR value for 10 g of exposed tissue is calculated for two cases of antenna position longitudinal and transversal. Results of the simulations and the SAR evaluation do not show the values exceeding the regulation limits. However, the distance and position of the device are important to choose with caution.

articleTitle: Mathematical Simulation of Processes in an Asynchronous Motor Powered by a Cable Line
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The article presents a mathematical model for the investigate of modes and characteristics of asynchronous motors (AM), which are located at a distance from the voltage source and powered through the cable line. The purpose of the article is to investigate the maximum allowable values of resistance of supply lines, at which AM can be started in the given operating conditions. The choice of capacitors included parallel to the motor, which are necessary to reduce the starting current to provide the maximum possible starting electromagnetic moment, is also considered. The calculation is based on the AM mathematical model, which takes into account the saturation of the magnetic core and the displacement of current in the bars of squirrel-cage rotor.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Linear Periodically-Time-Variable Circuits by the Frequency Symbolic Method with Application the D-Trees Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: In this paper we analyze the application of the matrix equation of L. A. Zadeh to symbolic analysis of the LPTV circuits in the frequency domain. The symbolic solution of the linear algebraic equations is proposed to be performed by the socalled the d-trees method. The main provisions of the d-trees method are analyzed. The examples that convince the high efficiency of the method of d-trees are given. The results are used in the design of amplifiers of special purpose.

articleTitle: Crack Geometry Estimation Error in Eddy-Current Non-Destructive Inversion
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The contribution deals with inverse task solution in electromagnetic non-destructive evaluation (eNDE). Austenitic stainless steel (AISI 316L) is investigated with presence of the artificial notches. Eddy current inspection with modular probe under harmonic excitation is used for the forward investigation. The inverse problem solution based on concrete mathematical methods is presented to investigate the defect geometry error estimation as a result of various influenced parameters. Based on computing algorithms, basic geometry of cracks is inversely estimated.

articleTitle: Basic Technical Principles Construction of Local Computer Systems for Managing of Technological Objects
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The methodology of the synthesis the topology of local networks is considered. The possible variants of the hardware structures of local networks for manufacturing automation and enterprise computing are shown. Calculation of traffic of local network is provided. Research results can be used to organize computations of complex tasks, in particular electrical engineering tasks that require considerable computing resources.

articleTitle: Method for Increasing the Rate of Current Rise in the Load of Electrical Discharge Installations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The change of the average rate of current rise in the load during oscillatory and aperiodic discharges of the reservoir capacitor of electrical discharge installations are studied. The regularities of changes of the average rate of discharge currents rise in the load at forced limitation their duration and different capacities of the reservoir capacitor are determined. It is proved that increasing the capacity of the capacitor reduces the duration of the discharge current rise from zero to any fixed value that is less than the amplitude value. On the basis of the studies, a method for increasing the rate of current rise in the load of electrical discharge installations is proposed. The method consists in increasing the capacity of a dischargeable capacitor (as compared to the required capacity) and interruption of the current in the load when the preset fixed current value is reached.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of the Effectiveness of Complex Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 20th International Conference on Computational Problems of Electrical Engineering (CPEE)
abstract: The problems of providing requirements to the parameters of the appointment of scientifically-powered devices during their design, production and operation are considered. The principles of complex evaluation of the effectiveness of different stages of the life cycle are analyzed. According to the results of the research, elements of the modeling theory of these processes have been developed using functional and economic criteria, and examples of models are given.
